rules: Static operation permission from ServicePassport remains mandatory.
For capability_control=REQUIRED, Kernel also requires an ACTIVE CapabilityReceipt for the same audience service + workspace + instance.
Grant capability IDs must be subset of Registry capability_ceiling.
Each guarded primitive operation is matched against Registry operation_guards; schema_ids narrow generic object operations.
Workspace module/contribution/command may additionally declare requiredCapabilitiesAll/Any. UI visibility is never sufficient; invocation re-check is mandatory.
If Registry says an operation is capability-guarded and no matching active capability exists, DENY even if static operation is granted.
Unknown capability ID, unknown guard metadata, unknown issuer, invalid signature, expired grant, binding mismatch, or required trusted-time failure => no ACTIVE receipt for that guarded action.

workspace_successor_shape.commands_invoke: re-checks static operations + capabilities after async loader

kernel_successor_shape.session: keeps static granted_operations and exposes read-only activeCapabilities/authorization view separately
